share.title: Umshweyelo wevidyo womuntu siqu uguqulelwe
share.text: Joyina umshweyelo wam wevidyo womuntu siqu uguqulelwe.
home.roomReady: Indawo ilungiselele — akukho omntu osele ozaye ujoyina.
home.confirmReplace: Vala indawo esebenzayo kwaye yenze enye entsha? Bonke abantu abakuso bayadobeka.
home.linkReady: Ikhonekithi yomuntu siqu yomntu onobandlela ilungiselele uku-yabelana.
home.createFailed: Ayikwazi ukuyenza kunye nokugcina indawo yomuntu siqu kulolo dlisi.
home.selectToCopy: Khetha kwaye kopa ikhonekithi yomntu onobandlela.
home.openBlocked: Ukuvula kuviliwe. Kopa ikhonekithi yomntu onobandlela endaweni yoko.
home.confirmClose: Vala lo duli ngoku? Bonke abantu bayadobeka kwaye ikhonekithi yomntu onobandlela iyakuthoma ukungasebenzi.
home.roomClosedLink: Lo duli uvaliwe. Ikhonekithi yayo yomntu onobandlela ayisasebenzi.
home.closeFailed: Ayikwazi ukuvala indawo. Ihlala igciniwe kulolo dlisi.
home.statusUnavailable: Isimo sendawo ayifumaneki okwexeshana. Ukulawulwa kuhlala kugciniwe kulolo dlisi.
home.needsUpdate: Olu poganyo alukwazi ukuxhuma okanye ludinga uhlengelelwano.
home.controlLost: Olo duli ludlulile okanye lungalawulwa ngumhlali olu.
gate.title: Khetha ulwimi
report.confirm: Thumela ingxelo yomuntu siqu kwaye vala lo duli kulolo dlisi?
report.sent: Ingxelo ithunyeliwe. Indawo ivaliwe kulolo dlisi.
captions.heading: Izibaniso
status.roomExpired: Olo duli lomuntu siqu ludlulile okanye alufumaneki
status.languagesUpdated: Ulwimi luhlengeleliwe — yalayisha kabukabusha ukuqhubela phambi
status.captionsBusy: Izibaniso ziqele. Zama kabukabusha ka {seconds} s.
status.linkCopied: Ikhonekithi yendawo yomuntu siqu ibenziwe ikopi
status.shareFailed: Ayikwazi ukuvula i-app yokuyabelana — kopa ikhonekithi yebha yedilesi
status.backgroundPaused: Umnxeba umiswe ngelixa i-Lingua Relay isetyenzisiwe kumva
note.askForNewRoom: Cela ummntu wokufaka ukuba yenze indawo entsha yomuntu siqu.
note.closedByHost: Olo duli lomuntu siqu luvaliwe ngumlawuli.
note.youLeft: Wena ushiye olo duli lomuntu siqu.
note.roomFull: Indawo izele. Ukuba omntu ulivale ivili, zama kabukabusha kwi-90 seconds.
note.videoFailed: Ividyo ayikwazi ukuxhuma kwizinketho zakho. Izibaniso zisasebenza.
note.videoSlow: Isakhuthaza ukuxhuma ividyo… izibaniso zisenziwa ngoku.
